newsitem.title: USA: General Motors files shelf for $1.3 bln debt.
newsitem.headline: General Motors files shelf for $1.3 bln debt.

text.p: General Motors Corp Wednesday filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission for up to $1.3 billion in debt securities.
When combined with previous registrations, General Motors will have $1.811 billion in debt securities.
Net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, the filing said.
Possible uses for the proceeds also include the repayment of existing debt, the automaker said in the filing.
A GM spokesperson was not immediately available for comment on the shelf registration.
